<documents>
<document id="close-inactivity">
InactiveˆaccountsˆWeˆmayˆcloseˆaccountsˆthatˆhaveˆaˆ$0.00ˆbalanceˆandˆnoˆactivityˆforˆ12ˆmonths.ˆ##ˆNoticeˆWeˆemailˆyouˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆclosing.ˆAnyˆactivityˆduringˆthatˆtime,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆdepositˆorˆaˆcardˆpurchase,ˆkeepsˆtheˆaccountˆopen.ˆ##ˆFeesˆWeˆdon'tˆchargeˆinactivityˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆAccountsˆwithˆmoneyˆinˆthemˆWeˆdon'tˆcloseˆaccountsˆforˆinactivityˆwhileˆtheyˆholdˆaˆbalance,ˆincludingˆmoneyˆinˆSavingsˆPockets.ˆ##ˆPaidˆplansˆAˆpaidˆplanˆkeepsˆchargingˆitsˆmonthlyˆfeeˆwhileˆtheˆaccountˆisˆopen,ˆwhichˆcountsˆasˆactivity.ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆuseˆyourˆaccount,ˆconsiderˆmovingˆtoˆBasic.ˆ##ˆComingˆbackˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆwasˆclosedˆforˆinactivity,ˆyouˆcanˆapplyˆforˆaˆnewˆoneˆwheneverˆyouˆlike.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆanˆaccountˆopenˆAnyˆcardˆpurchase,ˆdepositˆorˆtransferˆcountsˆasˆactivity.ˆSigningˆinˆtoˆtheˆappˆonˆitsˆownˆdoesn't.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-fraud-lock">
WhyˆisˆmyˆcardˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook?ˆIfˆtheˆappˆsaysˆyourˆcardˆisˆ"LockedˆbyˆTallowbrook",ˆourˆfraudˆsystemsˆhaveˆplacedˆaˆfraudˆlockˆonˆit.ˆThisˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆaˆfreezeˆyouˆsetˆyourself.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆWeˆlockˆaˆcardˆwhenˆweˆseeˆactivityˆthatˆlooksˆlikeˆfraud,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆfraudˆalertˆgoesˆunansweredˆforˆ24ˆhours.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆgetˆitˆremovedˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆanˆopenˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆanswerˆit.ˆTappingˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆusuallyˆremovesˆtheˆlockˆstraightˆaway.ˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆnoˆalert,ˆmessageˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆtheˆFraudˆteam.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆremoveˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆandˆneitherˆcanˆtheˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆoftenˆmuchˆsooner.ˆ##ˆMeanwhileˆDepositsˆandˆincomingˆtransfersˆstillˆarriveˆwhileˆyourˆcardˆisˆlocked.ˆYouˆcanˆalsoˆstillˆuseˆBrookPayˆandˆtransfers,ˆunlessˆtheˆFraudˆteamˆhasˆrestrictedˆthoseˆtoo.ˆWeˆwillˆneverˆaskˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆaˆfraudˆalertˆbyˆgivingˆusˆyourˆfullˆcardˆnumber,ˆPINˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcode.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
WhatˆchangedˆinˆtheˆMarchˆ2026ˆfeeˆupdateˆWeˆupdatedˆourˆfeesˆonˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆHere'sˆeverythingˆthatˆchangedˆandˆwhatˆstayedˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangedˆ-ˆ**Plusˆmonthlyˆfee:**ˆfromˆ$4.00ˆtoˆ$5.00.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆfromˆ1.5%ˆtoˆ1%.ˆ-ˆ**Out-of-networkˆATMˆfeeˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus:**ˆfromˆ$2.00ˆtoˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawals:**ˆfromˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstayedˆtheˆsameˆBasicˆisˆstillˆfree.ˆPremiumˆisˆstillˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonthˆwithˆnoˆATMˆorˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees.ˆCardˆreplacement,ˆwireˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfeesˆdidn'tˆchangeˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhyˆweˆmadeˆtheseˆchangesˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆoperatorsˆraisedˆwhatˆtheyˆchargeˆus,ˆandˆweˆmovedˆpartˆofˆthatˆcostˆintoˆtheˆfee.ˆWeˆloweredˆtheˆPlusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆatˆtheˆsameˆtime,ˆsoˆPlusˆmembersˆwhoˆtravelˆpayˆlessˆoverall.ˆIfˆtheˆnewˆPlusˆpriceˆdoesn'tˆworkˆforˆyou,ˆyouˆcanˆmoveˆtoˆBasicˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
